problem: Native PowerPoint grouped drawings failed a solver-header check; native image catalogs failed an unsupported UID-equality check. Content-placeholder tables and media/OLE frames lost their typed content. Custom shows returned empty lists and used ID arithmetic rather than current order. Passive VBA source failed on native sync-flushed storage.
changes: OfficeArt solver recInstance is a rule count. Validate direct rule framing/counts and charge rules to the shared drawing budget; other shape-container instance fields still require zero.

Resolve image slots by physical offset, selected kind and exact size. Keep FBSE pixel-data UID and BLIP file-data UID independently without requiring equality. Tests retain wrong-kind/size/truncation refusals.
Keep Table, Group and Picture projections when those shapes occupy content placeholders. Native table cells and media/OLE/image identities survive instead of becoming empty text placeholders.

Use the existing strict NamedShows owner with the presentation source limits and one aggregate parse budget. Read only the live document and resolve membership through stable IDs in current logical order, including after append-only slide moves.

Recognize native sync-flush-terminated storage explicitly. Decode under exact declared size and output cap, then verify the actual block boundary by completing only the in-memory inflater with an empty final block and computed Adler trailer. Preserve original bytes. Finished streams still follow the strict zlib path; truncation, size mismatch and trailing data stay errors.
Reuse bounded storage decoding for embedded charts and preserve finished versus sync-flushed encoding when replacing their payloads.
Add native group/table/image/media/custom-show/source-edit/encryption/VBA tests and one public-facade table query/edit/inverse test. Add a CI step for native PPT tests without optional encryption.

Update the DOC protection corpus baseline from 58/50 to 75/66 total/comparable documents after independently verifying all 75 tracked DOC fixtures are materialized and no untracked DOC files contribute. The 17 native additions include 16 plaintext documents and one encrypted specimen.
api_changes: Presentation::custom_shows now returns Result<Vec<ParsedCustomShow>> so malformed metadata and source/resource failures are observable. Repository callers were updated.
embedded::storage::Compression adds ZlibSyncFlush. Metadata exposes this native encoding instead of describing it as a complete zlib stream; exhaustive consumers need the new variant.
